original_ai_output.title_zh: 利益相关方呼吁以社区驱动行动改善癌症早筛与治疗
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚约贝州恩古鲁举行Pinktober 2026东北部癌症宣传活动市政厅会议，由癌症意识倡议组织远程肿瘤中心主办。与会利益相关方呼吁采取社区驱动行动，提升癌症早期发现率、扩大治疗可及性并加强合作以减少乳腺癌死亡。会议呼吁建立多学科癌症管理团队，并鼓励传统与宗教领袖参与减少污名化。

key_facts.fact: 利益相关方在尼日利亚约贝州恩古鲁举行会议，呼吁以社区驱动行动改善癌症早筛与治疗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They made the call on Wednesday at a town hall meeting marking the Pinktober 2026 Northeast Cancer Campaign, organised by the Cancer Consciousness Initiative (CCI) TeleOncology Hub in Nguru, Yobe.

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚癌症协会FMC恩古鲁分会主席阿德巴约表示，乳腺癌仍是主要死因之一，需采取实际行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Adebayo noted that breast cancer remained one of the major causes of mortality, stressing the need for practical action beyond awareness campaigns.

key_facts.fact: 活动主题为“从意识到可及”，由多方合作举办
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The campaign, with the theme, “Awareness to Access”, was organised in partnership with the Federal Medical Centre (FMC), Nguru, Northeast Development Commission, Nigerian Cancer Society and other stakeholders.

uncertainties: 目前仅一个来源（尼日利亚通讯社）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
